body:
Code looks good to me (didn't test, I don't have an affected device).

This also adds a verbose print that states whether ubershaders are enabled, which I think is a good thing.
Looks good to me. Still no word no what other driver/compiler versions to look out for, so let's go ahead with this minimal approach for now and update the check later as needed

I was also able to reproduce this crash on my Samsung Tab S7 (Android 13, Adreno 650). This PR fixes the crash.

On Firebase Test Lab, the tests are unreliable; they are sometimes terminated prematurely without any crashes. I can only confirm the crashes on three `Galaxy S20` (Ultra 5G / + 5G /   FE 5G) devices, Android 13, Adreno 650.
